Why isn't the vegetable soup on your lunch menu today?
A. It suits you well.
B. The same amount of water.
C. We're offering French onion soup.
context.transcript_translation:
你午餐菜单上为什么没有蔬菜汤？
A. 它很适合你。
B. 同等量的水。
C. 我们提供法式洋葱汤。

items.question: Why isn't the vegetable soup on your lunch menu today?
